WESTWARD AT 21 KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS. THE CIRCULATION HAS
BECOME ILL-DEFINED IN SATELLITE AND RADAR IMAGERY, AND SURFACE
OBSERVATIONS OVER JAPAN REVEAL VERY WEAK PRESSURE GRADIENTS AND
NO WELL-DEFINED CIRCULATION PATTERN. MAXIMUM SURFACE WINDS OFFSHORE
TO THE NORTH OF HONSHU WERE UP TO 30 KT IN EARLIER SCATTEROMETER

WEAKENING OVER THE NEXT 24 HOURS. THIS IS THE FINAL WARNING ON THIS
SYSTEM BY THE JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI. THE SYSTEM WILL
BE CLOSELY MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF REGENERATION. MINIMUM CENTRAL
PRESSURE AT 111800Z IS 994 MB. MAXIMUM SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT
111800Z IS 12 FEET.
